types.name: Discovery build
types.description: Novel work with no approved playbook. Always Opus; credits never downgrade it.

types.name: Feature build
types.description: Feature work. Opus until a playbook is approved, then Sonnet (the distillation payoff).

types.name: Bug triage (read-only)
types.description: Read-only diagnosis of an intake ticket. No credentials, no file changes, diagnosis budget enforced.

types.name: Bug fix
types.description: Implements an approved fix plan and pushes to a UAT branch.

types.name: Data / schema migration
types.description: Risky: never rolls over mid-operation; data-touching steps bounce to the Approver.

types.name: Test repair
types.description: Fix failing tests following the test-repair playbook.

types.name: Rollback verification
types.description: Checks out a pinned tag on a new branch and runs that state's acceptance tests before anything touches main.
